reviewer: json_scope, independent of root integration and runtime production converter patches
scope: Static engineering review of final frozen integration and converter source patches; exact final-WAR/runtime acceptance remains separately recorded.
observations: Explicit NO-JPEG2000 requires NO-ORACLE, a selected variant map and an affected target before output mutation; guarded source is prepared before compiler-input snapshot. Maven package still compiles test sources.
Runtime profile validates exact WAR, profile manifest and selected Marlin/JSON/ImageIO hashes during load and immediately before launch.
Source WAR probe validates every selected component/source-evidence digest, rejects duplicate target definitions, extracts actual WAR libraries and rechecks WAR/JAR/map identities after execution.

Aggregate inspection verifies exact guarded source outputs, compiled-to-packaged class bytes, web.xml, frozen scanner identity and exact replacement map. Failed nested scans raise instead of reporting successful aggregate evidence.

PDFTileRenderer outer class and anonymous $1 both bind compiler output hashes; checkPdf/readBounded are checked in the anonymous class where the calls actually occur. Prior failed marker checks remain historical receipts.

All six importer converter classes require the fixed request diagnostic and HttpMessageNotReadableException markers; TransformChain also requires its native transformChain call. Source before/after hashes independently checked.

Converter source patches catch only JSONException with a fixed diagnostic and no original cause while retaining stream cleanup. The chain delegation repair uses the existing native vector/raster parser; its baseline failures are preserved.
review_limits: The six-converter production patches were independently reviewed; json_scope authored their native witness, so no independent review of that witness is claimed. Actual final-WAR HTTP400 remains required separately.
This is not legal/license approval, owner candidate acceptance or evidence that unexecuted final runtime checks passed.
